## Documentation Issue

### Type
- [ ] Missing documentation
- [ ] Incorrect/outdated documentation
- [ ] Confusing/unclear documentation
- [ ] Broken links
- [ ] Typos/grammar

### Location

Where is the documentation issue?
- [ ] README.md
- [ ] AGENTS.md
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger)
- [ ] Code comments/godoc
- [ ] Architecture docs (`docs/architecture/`)
- [ ] Operations docs (`docs/operations/`)
- [ ] Migration guides
- [ ] Domain contract docs (`domains/*/contracts/`)
- [ ] SDK docs (`sdk/`)
- [ ] Example docs (`examples/*/`)
- [ ] Docker/Compose docs
- [ ] CI/CD docs
- [ ] Other: ___________

### Current Behavior

What does the documentation currently say (or what is missing)?

### Expected Behavior

What should the documentation say?

### Suggested Fix

If you have a specific fix in mind, describe it here.

### Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or references here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have verified this against the current `main` branch
